newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume falls, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume falls, prices mixed.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange fell to 689 kilos on Friday from 719 on Thursday as traders were sidelined amid expectations that world prices might go down further, dealers said.
Gold fell to $377.75 an ounce from $378.80 on Thursday, but rose in lira terms to 1,216,000 lira per gram from 1,213,400 due to a weak lira.

"Gold demand was weak because the market expected a further drop. Traders kept to the sidelines after they made losses from gold positions they bought at higher prices earlier in the week," a dealer said.
First session volume was 302 kilos and second session was 387 kilos. 57 percent of the total turnover was in dollar terms. -- Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
